releases.name: Vampire Survivors: Legacy of the Blood Moon
releases.summary:
In ancient times, Saint Baal'Thasar had a vision of paradise, lit by a bright, red moon. And so he founded the Order of the Red Moon, to lead people to a land of eternal life. The myth says that Baal'Thasar found his paradise during a pilgrimage, and so never returned.

Having lost its leader, the Order shattered and many fringe sects were born from its remnants. Today, members of one of the most unscrupulous cults, Clan Bloodmoon, embarks on a journey to follow in Baal'Thasar's footsteps...

releases.name: Delivery Simulator
releases.summary:
Parcels don’t deliver themselves, and the city won’t make things easy for you. Take the wheel and face the intense daily grind of a delivery driver, navigating busy streets, tight shortcuts, and surprises at every corner. Collect orders, load the cargo, and plan the best route to arrive on time.

Unlock achievements by completing special objectives, beating the clock without crashing your car, and maintaining delivery streaks with no delays. More challenges mean more reasons to improve with every run!

The goal is simple: deliver as much as possible, earn rewards, buy a variety of insane vehicles, and upgrade your operation to become a true reference in the city. Because here, every second counts and every delivery makes a difference!

releases.name: Art of Drift - Cozy Drift Simulator
releases.summary:
Feel the drift, not the rush

Drifting isn’t about speed — it’s about control, flow, and style.

Step into a relaxed yet skill-based drifting experience where every corner is an opportunity to build momentum and score. Set across snowy tracks with a clean low-poly aesthetic, the game focuses on smooth driving, precision, and maintaining long, controlled drifts.

Chain together turns, control your angle, and keep your speed to build higher scores. The closer you get to obstacles and the longer you hold your drift, the more rewarding each run becomes. Every mistake breaks your flow, so staying focused is key.

Use handbrake turns to initiate drifts and nitro boosts to maintain speed through long curves. As you progress, unlock new cars with different handling styles and explore new locations designed to challenge your control and creativity behind the wheel.

releases.name: Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters
releases.summary:
The next episode of Tsubasa’s riveting adventure is here! Enjoy the thrill of spectacular soccer actions with 110 playable characters and new sensational super moves. 

CAPTAIN TSUBASA 2: WOLRD FIGHTERS invites fans to follow their journey to victory by creating their own character and joining Tsubasa on his quest. Players will forge new friendships, fight new rivals, and bring the trophy back home.

Action on the field has been significantly enhanced for this new release. New super moves increase the intensity of every part of the game, allowing players to dominate the field when they pass, dribble, tackle or block with their own special techniques.

Even blocking goal shots becomes more tactical with a new system that pits goalkeeper against shooter, letting both players experience and counter jaw dropping super shots and blocks from characters of the original series.

releases.name: 1964 Operation Velvet Twins
releases.summary:
You play as Secret Agent Mike Rogers, assigned to track down and capture the fugitive terrorists known only as the Velvet Twins. Set across stylish, danger-filled locations, you’ll fight through unforgettable 1960s stages - from neon-lit Las Vegas, gritty Chinatown, and abandoned factories, all the way to a shootout in a Wild West village!

Originally appearing as a boss in Dragon Climax, Mike now takes center stage. He can take down enemies with his bare hands, but when things get serious, he'll grab whatever weapons are available - from pistols and swords to baseball bats and even a submachine gun.

1964: Operation Velvet Twins delivers pure retro fun with no filler - just tight gameplay, explosive action, and an unmistakable 8-bit flavor. If you loved the golden era of your Master System, you're going to feel right at home.

releases.name: Hoversteppers
releases.summary: Hoversteppers is a freestyle hoverboard skating game. Flip, spin, and test your boarding skills with timed challenges across multiple stages.

releases.name: Palabras en ingles para aprender en la primaria
releases.summary:
Ready for first English words?

Can your child build English confidence one word at a time?

Words learned early can make school feel a little easier. This quiz game helps kids practice basic English vocabulary in a fun, low-pressure way.

How to play:
・Look closely at the picture
・Pick the matching English word from 4 choices
・Get it right to read a detailed explanation

releases.name: WordHive 3
releases.summary:
Build words, score points, and master the hive.

Word Hive 3 is a word puzzle game where each puzzle gives you eight letters: seven outer letters and one required center letter. Use them to create as many words as possible. Every word must include the center letter.

Letters may be used more than once, and each word must contain at least four letters. Longer words earn more points, while special words that use all eight letters, known as pangrams, award bonus points.

Put your mind to the test with every puzzle, discover new words, expand your vocabulary, and enjoy a rewarding word puzzle experience.

Increase your score to climb the global ranks, uncover every hidden word, and become the ultimate word master.

Word Hive 3 uses an British English dictionary.

releases.name: Research Story
releases.summary:
Tame creatures, grow crops, and record your findings!

Discover and record 90+ plants, creatures, and fish at various locations around Shimmerbrook, and contribute your findings to the Archive.

Features
- Tame and raise 32 unique creatures
- Observe wild plants and grow them as crops based on different requirements
- Meet over 20 townsfolk, attend town festivals, go on hangout events
- Date and marry one of the 10 romanceable candidates
- Dig deep into the mines, fish, solve puzzles and uncover the mystery behind Shimmerbrook
- Cook, craft, build, and more!

Your life as a researcher starts today!

releases.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Baekje Military Museum
releases.summary:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone.

There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3.

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Baekje Military Museum, Korea with "Real" footage!

releases.name: Fernkeep
releases.summary: Discover the quiet charm of a medieval castle town.

releases.name: Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker - Master Collection Version
releases.summary:
In 1964, Naked Snake, who saved the world from the threat of all-out nuclear war between the United States and the Soviet Union, was hailed as a true hero and bestowed the title "BIGBOSS." However, after the award ceremony, Snake disappeared...

Ten years later, Snake, who had organized his own army in Colombia, South America, is visited by a visitor from Costa Rica, a country without an army.

Costa Rica, a region of Latin America that holds the key to the East-West power balance since the Cuban Missile Crisis, has miraculously maintained peace. However, mysterious armed groups have been making suspicious moves across the country. 

They ask Snake to investigate and eliminate the group. 

Snake hesitates to accept the request, but the tape they bring contains the voice of The Boss, who was supposed to be dead.

releases.name: Golftacular!
releases.summary:
Golftacular! is mini-golf... barely. Mix party game chaos and dumb fun with precision and strategy.

Up to 4 players take turns as Tortillo, Chuck, Fin, Poop, Papa, Mama, Claude, and Frend, each one aiming for the hole while unleashing chaos on anyone foolish enough to stand in the way.

Enjoy endless replayability with dozens of handcrafted courses and thousands of possible item combos. Items shake up everything: turn the course into your personal parkour playground or an obstacle-filled nightmare for your opponents. Call in airstrikes, play rock-paper-scissors, give your ball wings, place portals... and that’s just the tip of the iceberg.

releases.name: 28 Days Train Wreck Survivor
releases.summary:
Stranded after a brutal train crash, your survival begins now.

You wake amidst twisted metal and shattered carriages, trapped between steep cliffs and a vast lake. With only your wits and determination, you must explore, gather, and fight to stay alive for 28 days — until rescue arrives.

Every decision counts. Every resource matters. Will you endure?

EXPLORE THE WRECKAGE
Search every train car for supplies, tools, and hidden loot. Some wagons are locked or contain only fragments of the gear you need, forcing you to combine parts and improvise to survive.

MASTER RESOURCE MANAGEMENT
Hunt, fish, forage mushrooms and berries, and collect wood. Keep fires burning, craft essential tools, and make every piece of salvaged material count.

CRAFT & SURVIVE
Build makeshift shelters, repair damaged gear, and create survival equipment from scavenged parts. Creativity and resourcefulness are the keys to lasting 28 days.

FACE THE WILD
The wilderness is dangerous — giant lizards and other predators lurk everywhere. Stay alert, defend yourself, and never underestimate the wildlife.

PLAN FOR THE 28-DAY CHALLENGE
Balance risk and reward. Explore further or stay safe. Every day brings hunger, cold, and new dangers — only careful planning and bold action will see you through.

CROSS-SAVE & CROSS-BUY
Start your struggle on PlayStation®4 and continue seamlessly on PlayStation®5. Your progress and your tools move with you — your fight for survival never has to stop.

Do you have the skill, patience, and grit to survive all 28 days?

releases.name: Scott Pilgrim EX: Back in the Band
releases.summary: A linha Grip foi criada para você que não vacila nas  decisões e tem firmeza nas suas escolhas. Com formato triangular que facilita a pegada com suas esferas antideslizantes, os materiais da linha Grip tem escrita macia, tinta durável e são confortáveis para escrever.“Escorrega Não”, campanha criada pela Faber-Castell com o intuito de deixar o dia a dia mais divertido e ajudar você nos estudos, com aplicativos de GripQuiz Faber-Castell é um jogo que vai testar as suas habilidades de reconhecimento e rapidez na resposta! O jogo é dividido em 6 categorias e cada categoria tem uma série de imagens para que você adivinhe e divirta-se jogando e desafiando seus amigos. Cada imagem tem um tempo máximo para resposta e, quanto mais rápido responder, mais pontos você ganha! Desafie seus amigos, compartilhe os resultados e mostre que você é o melhor!Bom jogo!

releases.name: I Did Not Buy This Ticket
releases.summary: Unique "match-three" game with classic gameplay!Do you like the sound of braking glass?Do you like cool animations, sound effects and music?Do you like challenging gameplay and unique atmosphere? Then you DEFINITELY SHOULD TRY GLASSIC !Glassic is a match-three game, it means you should move balls to get line of 3 or more balls to remove it and score points. Try removing bigger combinations to get more points. On each level you will have to remove required amount of balls to complete level. Completing each level gives you bonus points. Completing higher levels gives more points, so try to reach higher levels. Good luck and have a great time playing our game!FEATURES:? GREAT ATMOSPHERE? CHALLENGING GAMEPLAY? UNIQUE SOUND EFFECTS AND ANIMATIONS? COOL ACHIEVEMENTS

releases.name: The Golden Idol Saga
releases.summary: You have a spare minute? Employ your time usefully!Discover iGenius – the first combination of crosswords and scanwords in one application!Crosswords enrich your mind, train your erudition, and widen the scope of your knowledge. Pass your free time in a useful way and our charming assistant will help you in that.There is no need to leaf through enormous papers, to buy thick scanword magazines, correct the answers you have already filled in – just install iGenius! Every month you’ll get new crosswords and scanwords. The collections are automatically updated, so you’ll always have something to wreck your brain over.  Each issue contains 99 tasks of different complexity levels.iGenius features:-6 free levels-3 levels of complexity-3 color schemes-regular updates -iGenius gives you hints – one letter, one word or even a whole crossword. Use the hint if the situation is desperate.-If you’ve made a mistake, iGenius robot, your assistant, will help you find one.-Original music and iPod playlists supportSimple: just delete a word and enter a new oneInteresting: original, authors’ crosswords and scanwords.User-friendly: intuitive interface.The application is free. Each month new paid issues of crosswords and scanwords!

releases.name: Magnetail
releases.summary:
Get ready to enter a world of clever inventions, smart challenges, and brilliant solutions in Magnetail. In this charming puzzle adventure, you follow an ingenious inventor mouse who transforms workshops, laboratories, and storage rooms into playgrounds of experimentation and discovery.

Each level presents a new challenge where energy, magnetism, and logic work together. Push energy modules, watch them slide across the environment, and use magnets strategically to redirect trajectories, create barriers, and open unexpected paths. It may seem simple at first, but you will quickly discover that every move can completely change the outcome of the puzzle.

The key is thinking several steps ahead. Where will the module stop? Which magnet should be used first? Which route leaves the path clear for the next move? In Magnetail, every decision matters, and finding the perfect solution is as satisfying as powering up a complex machine for the very first time.

Explore 30 carefully crafted levels spread across busy workshops, experimental laboratories, and storage facilities filled with mechanical challenges. New situations constantly emerge, requiring observation, planning, and creativity to master the rules of magnetism and turn obstacles into opportunities.

With charming visuals, accessible controls, and puzzles that reward intelligence and experimentation, Magnetail delivers a relaxing, engaging, and highly rewarding experience. It is the kind of game that makes you stop, study the room for a moment, and then smile when the perfect solution finally clicks into place.

Align the modules, master the magnets, and prove that no invention is too complex for a brilliant mind.

releases.name: Monst
releases.summary:
Devour and destroy the world. Fighting against armed forces with various transformations. Obtain energy, numerous weapons and abilities.

Players take on the role of an alien monster, devouring and fighting against human armed forces with various transformations, and annihilating the world. By continuously devouring humans to obtain energy, numerous weapons and abilities can be added to combat human armed forces and eliminate the world. When encountering different extraterrestrial crystals, one can acquire different superpowers. And it can have different transformations in different situations, experiencing super destructive power.

This is a Roguelike game where players operate an alien monster to devour humans, obtaining dozens of weapons, shields, and more through the energy gained Buff、 Follow the ball, fire different energy bullets, and merge these bullets for firing. Different follower balls can also attack in different ways.

In the game, there are randomly encountered alien crystals that can acquire different superpowers, providing abilities such as freezing, fire breathing, and protective shields, making the game process more interesting.

In the game, you can also have different transformations and experience super destructive power. If it can transform into a super ape with invincible power, it can directly destroy houses and police cars in the city.

releases.name: AMEL BROAT
releases.summary:
From the creators of "Cresteaju," the legendary indie RPG is completely reborn! Experience a new story of "wind" woven in a 2.5D world with reconstructed music, full voice acting, and stunning visuals.

This is an epic story revolving around the "Sword of the Sixteenth Night" and the "wind," passed down from the age of myths. The thoughts and destinies of various people - the goofy Alya, the sea urchin-loving Tine, the bell pepper-hating priest Hiro, the self-proclaimed hero Seil, the Russaine Empire which seeks the power of the "Sword of the Sixteenth Night," and the guilds of the neighboring Baltesia Federation - will liven up the game with full voice acting. 

The free RPG "AMEL BROAT," released in 1997 when indie games were still minor, became a huge hit with its touching and humorous content, and has now been completely remade.

The story has been expanded with a deeper world view and significantly increased in volume. What happens "afterwards"...?

releases.name: Escape game R00M16
releases.summary:
Explore 3D space and escape

Move through 3D space to find hints, solve mysteries and escape from the room.
Anyone can play to the end because you can see hints and answers.

releases.name: Hidden Cats in Barcelona
Inside the Cube
releases.summary: Lost between endless rooms.

releases.name: Supermarket Electronic
releases.summary: Mercenary Might is a turn-based strategy game set in European mythology, creating a casual, relaxed style of heroic battle. As the story unfolds, mankind unites to battle the gods themselves. They have to use every stratagem they can devise to save themselves from extinction.In the game, each hero can only move one square each round. The player can form them into teams, and the heroes will gain experience and level up to become stronger through battles. Defeating an enemy will reward corresponding gold, and with enough gold, enemy units can be bought over to the player's side. The game contains a variety of units, some 20 in all including ordinary and elite units. Double-click to buy over an enemy unit, and move around the battlefield with the left mouse button and the middle circle is used to skip the round.
